verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ingests data through the open OpenTelemetry standard and OTLP, so instrumentation can be redirected to another backend when leaving. Its API lets you programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers and SLOs, which gives some route to extracting configuration. However, nothing in the evidence documents bulk export of stored telemetry events in an open format, so the core 'export all my data' part is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented bulk/raw event data export, open export formats for stored telemetry, export of boards/triggers/SLO definitions as portable files, independent confirmation of a clean exit path.
